name: VetStack
tagline: A savings desk for military life, from purchases to benefits
description: Built by a veteran for the whole military household, it takes money one decision at a time: purchase search, project spending plans, subscription reviews, receipt audits, and pointers to benefits already earned. The aim is fewer impulse buys and fewer benefits left unclaimed.
author: kenashe
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
